Select/Select.react.tsx: the defaultValue taken from the selected items, since React warns on selected on an option, and a <selectedcontent> that hydration leaves to the browser, neither of which the Astro file expresses
Select/Select.svelte: the value and the defaultValue taken from the selected items, which the Astro file doesn't express: bind:value takes one option from the page while its value is undefined, also on a multiple select
Select/Select.vue: a value without v-model set by a client-only directive and the options of a bound select marked on the server only, which the Astro file doesn't express: Vue's server render prints a value on the select and marks only the options that are its direct children
